title: Highest-frequency band
statement:
Which has the shortest characteristic wavelength among these bands?

[_]{a}

explanations: Their band is at the short-wavelength end.
Infrared is longer wavelength than visible ultraviolet.
These are on the long-wavelength side.
Shorter than visible light, but longer than gamma rays on the standard spectrum.

hints: Compare listed regions on that scale.
Gamma radiation lies at the high-frequency end.
solution: Recall the long-to-short spectrum. Compare listed regions on that scale. Gamma radiation lies at the high-frequency end. Their band is at the short-wavelength end.
